title: Distinguish pending federation durability from a changed authority fence
outcome: Federation requests can recognize a temporary unresolved durability fence separately from real authority invalidation, preserve unrelated healthy links, and recover the exact write without admitting uncertain work.
acceptance: Use a distinct bounded retryable pending-durability result while retaining stale-authority rejection for actual identity/configuration/incarnation changes.
Document and test L1 handling plus exact explicit durability reconciliation; pending or failed persistence never grants admission.
